jannisteunissen/config_fortran.manifest:
name = "config-fortran"
version = "0.0.0"
license = "GPL-3.0"
[library]
source-dir = "playground-library"
[build]
auto-executables = false
auto-examples = false
auto-tests = false
[install]
library = true

scope: Documented configuration values. An FPM wrapper selects unchanged m_config.f90. The main creates its own tiny configuration file, overrides integer, logical, string and grouped real defaults, reads a dynamically sized real array, checks every value and clears the configuration. No uploaded data file or external service is required. Command-line parsing, invalid-file diagnostics and all string/array/grouping behavior are not validated.

source_packaging.note: Only the listed unchanged library files are copied into playground-library; upstream test/program files are excluded.
